{{Quote|I was a pilot in the Ividal Sector Forces&mdash;Foxfire Squadron&mdash;when the Republic came calling. They had ground troops, but they needed their fighter squadrons over at Uvadala, so they came our way looking for dirt flyers.|[[Jorn Kulish]]|<ref name="EAOC" />}}
'''Uvadala''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref> located in the [[Uvadala system/Legends|Uvadala system]], a part of the [[Ividal sector/Legends|Ividal sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Uvadala was the site of a military operation which saw the participation of several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the Republic intended to eliminate [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] starfighter bases on [[Ongary IX]]. Since the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] could not spare its squadrons dispatched at Uvadala, the Republic instead recruited the [[Foxfire Squadron]] of the local [[Ividal Sector Forces]] and its [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] for the upcoming [[Attack on Ongary IX|attack]] on Ongary IX.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uvadala was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding Uvadala was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Uvadala [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the astronomical object Uvadala, in grid square P-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
